title: Motion Foundry
subtitle: Same move. Six ways to give it character.
description: Compare six animation principles in paired plain and expressive scenes. Tune timing, anticipation, squash and stretch, arcs, overshoot, and follow-through with reversible scrubbing and visible motion guides.
instruction: Choose a principle, compare the two treatments, and scrub the shared timeline. Change amplitude or easing, then replay to see what each choice does.
